messages:
maya (PM): RFC draft: Consolidate chat/completions + embeddings + rerank into a single 'rerank path' for Redwood API. Link: https://rwd/notes/CHAT-RERANK-DRAFT. Need quick triage: acceptance criteria, SLOs, rollout plan, and any hard blockers. Aiming for beta in ~4w. :eyes:

sahil (Eng): skimmed. two quick asks: 1) what's the latency budget for hosted? 2) are we changing the public API surface (breaking) or adding new endpoints? 

maya (PM): good Q. Proposal: add a non-breaking optional param `rerank=true` on completions/chat request that triggers server-side shortlisting + reranking. MVP will be additive only. Latency target for hosted: p95 end-to-end < 400ms for short chat turns (<=256 tokens), p95 < 800ms for longer responses. We'll settle exact numbers but want something measurable.

jamie (ML): from ranking perspective we need clear eval acceptance: NDCG@10 uplift >= 0.12 vs baseline on customer prompt set OR reranker A/B with p<0.05. Also need fallback: if embeddings service times out, degrade to model-only output. What's our SLA for embedding calls?

kelly (DevEx): SDK impact: clients will need examples for new param. Suggest adding `response_mode: "model_only" | "shortlist_then_rerank"` to keep explicit. Also we should publish migration notes and a quick sample in JS/Python.

andrew (QA): test plan notes: unit schema validation, e2e with mocked reranker, load tests with concurrent rerank calls, negative cases (empty candidate set, timeout on embeddings, malformed vectors). Also regression tests for streaming behaviour w/ rerank (does it stream?).

sahil (Eng): streaming: MVP won't stream reranked result token-by-token; we'll return final message once rerank completes. That avoids partial results and simplifies correctness. We should document that streaming isn't supported when `rerank=true` for now.

maya (PM): acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- API: optional param added, non-breaking
- SLOs: p95 latency targets defined and verified under load
- Quality: evaluation harness shows >= 0.12 NDCG@10 uplift or equivalent A/B
- SDK: examples in JS/Python and migration notes
- Telemetry: events for shortlist_time, rerank_time, fallback_reason
- Telemetry: record candidate_counts and embedding_time
- QA: test matrix executed
- Rollout: canary + 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on errors
- Privacy: no persistent storage of intermediate embeddings for hosted customers unless opted-in
```

jamie (ML): add metric: `rerank_inference_success_rate` and `ndcg_by_prompt_bucket`. Also we need offline eval harness and an integration test that runs reranker on a 1k prompt set.

kelly (DevEx): sample JS snippet for docs:
```
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'rwd-chat-1',
  messages: [{role:'user', content:'Find docs about billing'}],
  response_mode: 'shortlist_then_rerank',
  rerank_options: {top_k: 20}
})
```

andrew (QA): edge case: what if embedding size increases (quantization mismatch) — add validation and friendly 4xx with guidance.

sahil (Eng): implementation notes: shortlisting will use existing embeddings index; reranker is a lightweight model on CPU/GPU depending on model size. We'll add timeouts: 250ms for shortlist, 400ms for rerank, overall deadline enforced by gateway.

maya (PM): scope negotiation: MVP will be hosted-only and server-side rerank. Dedicated/Private support (customer-managed indexes, opt-in persistence) scheduled in Q2. A/B experiment controls will be delayed to post-beta to simplify rollout.

deploy-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pulls/72 — draft impl + tests. :rocket:

kelly (DevEx): also need changelog entry and sample curl example for ops teams.

martin (Legal): quick flag: confirm that we do not retain intermediate embeddings by default for hosted. If any customer requests storage, legal needs contract clause and opt-in audit trail.

maya (PM): confirmed — default is ephemeral only; persistent storage is opt-in for enterprise with controls.

sahil (Eng): blocker check: any non-technical blocker? infra quota for reranker GPUs? if so, we need capacity request.

ops-bot: infra request ticket opened: INFRA-4521 (gpu pool allocation). 

andrew (QA): will schedule test runs next Tue. Ping me when PR moves out of draft. :thumbsup:

maya (PM): thanks all. next steps: ENG to lock SLO numbers in PR, ML to finalize eval suite, DevEx to prepare SDK snippets, QA to draft test plan. We'll reconvene Friday for go/no-go. :calendar:
